description: Find real, priced ATA stays when the traveler is flexible. Defaults to a window 28–56 days from today, three nights, and two adults only when those values are missing; always return those defaults as explicit assumptions. Preferences are soft ranking signals, not a closed taxonomy.

amenities.description: Optional soft amenity preferences for flexible discovery.

earliestCheckIn.description: Earliest acceptable check-in date. Defaults to 28 days from today.

latestCheckIn.description: Latest acceptable check-in date. Defaults to 56 days from today.

location.description: Optional city, state, country, neighborhood, or building. Omit when the traveler is open to ATA's current destinations.

maxPriceCurrency.description: Currency for maxPrice when filtering mixed native currencies.

maxResults.description: Maximum priced stays to return. Defaults to 4.

nights.description: Length of stay. Defaults to 3 nights.

preferences.description: Open-ended soft preferences inferred from the traveler's own words or live network facets.

propertyType.description: Optional soft property-type preference; it ranks results and is reported as a difference when unavailable.

views.description: Optional soft view preferences for flexible discovery.

name: search_flexible_network_availability
